last_message:
Implemented `ProfileStore.update_profile` with atomic validation and copy-safe returns.

Changed [profile_store.py](<isolated-repository>/profile_store.py) and [tests/test_profile_store.py](<isolated-repository>/tests/test_profile_store.py).
